cli.hub_org_help.org: Your organization's shared agents, teams and skills (Radient Team)
cli.hub_org_help.list: List the organization catalogue and how each item sits locally
cli.hub_org_help.pull: Pull the organization catalogue and stay subscribed to updates
cli.hub_org_help.org_flag: Organization name, unique name prefix or tenant id (defaults to your only eligible organization)
cli.hub_org_help.name: Only this item: a hub id, name or unique name prefix (repeatable)

cli.hub_org_help.no_llm: Never call a model to merge differing copies
cli.hub_org_help.yes: Apply the plan instead of only printing it
